blocking_findings.finding: Reparse-point rejection is incomplete for nested path components. safe_child canonicalizes the candidate/parent and checks only the final entry or immediate parent, so an intermediate symlink/junction/reparse component can be traversed if canonical containment remains inside the configured root. This does not verify the required rejection of symlink/junction/reparse paths at every component.
evidence: validate_existing_components is applied to the root, but not to the original relative path components used by safe_child
No focused test covers nested symlink/junction/reparse components

important_findings.finding: The Rust implementation otherwise establishes strong authority boundaries: Owner-scoped configured roots, canonical containment, no overwrite/delete, preview-time Rust identity capture, immediate pre-rename identity checks, bounded multi-move execution, rollback attempts, compensation identity checks, and persisted failure/audit state.
The caller-supplied sourceIdentity is ignored during preview and replaced with Rust-captured identity. Compatibility parsing remains optional and bounded in the TypeScript contract.
Collection limits are present for moves, permissions, roots, catalog, sessions, and audit, including insertion/list enforcement where inspected.
Migration 0023 rebuilds the tool tables while preserving existing rows and adds local workspace manifests/roots. The reviewed code keeps SQLite/Rust authoritative.
Documentation correctly marks Phase 9 as functional with human validation pending and does not claim stable release.

scope_checks: No network, shell execution, upload, telemetry, watcher, public listener, raw-content persistence, provider credentials, or Phase 10+ behavior found in the reviewed Phase 9 changes.
UI invokes Rust commands and cannot independently approve, confirm, execute, or compensate actions.
Fixture adapters and local filesystem adapters are distinct in Rust and UI labels.
security_checks: Absolute and traversal paths are rejected by relative-path validation.
Source substitutions are rejected before rename and revalidated immediately before each rename.
Compensation preflights all reverse moves and validates stable destination identities.
